kv4.7:5.3: yādiso bodhisattassa pubbayogo pubbacariyā dhammakkhānaṃ dhammadesanā, tādiso cakkavattisattassa pubbayogo pubbacariyā dhammakkhānaṃ dhammadesanā’ti.
kv4.7:6.1: yathā bodhisattassa jāyamānassa devā paṭhamaṃ paṭigaṇhanti pacchā manussā, evamevaṃ cakkavattisattassa jāyamānassa devā paṭhamaṃ paṭigaṇhanti pacchā manussā’ti.
kv4.7:7.1: yathā bodhisattassa jāyamānassa cattāro naṃ devaputtā paṭiggahetvā mātu purato ṭhapenti
kv4.7:7.3: mahesakkho tava putto uppanno’ti, evamevaṃ cakkavatti sattassa jāyamānassa cattāro naṃ devaputtā, paṭiggahetvā mātu purato ṭhapenti
kv4.7:8.1: yathā bodhisattassa jāyamānassa dve udakadhārā antalikkhā pātubhavanti:
kv4.7:8.3: yena bodhisattassa udakakiccaṃ karonti mātu ca, evamevaṃ cakkavattissa jāyamānassa dve udakadhārā antalikkhā pātubhavanti:
kv4.7:8.5: yena cakkavattisattassa udakakiccaṃ karonti mātu cāti.
kv4.7:9.1: yathā sampatijāto bodhisatto samehi pādehi patiṭṭhahitvā uttarena abhimukho sattapadavītihārena gacchati, setamhi chatte anudhāriyamāne sabbā ca disā viloketi, āsabhiñca vācaṃ bhāsati:
kv4.7:9.2: aggohamasmi lokassa, jeṭṭhohamasmi lokassa, soṭṭhohamasmi lokassa, ayamantimājāti, natthī dāni punabbhavo’ti, evamevaṃ sampatijāto cakkavattisatto samehi pādehi patiṭṭhahitvā uttarena abhimukho sattapadavītihārena gacchati, setamhi chatte anudhāriyamāne sabbā ca disā viloketi, āsabhiñca vācaṃ bhāsati.
kv4.7:10.1: yathā bodhisattassa jāyamānassa mahato ālokassa mahato obhāsassa mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvo hoti, evamevaṃ cakkavattissa jāyamānassa mahato ālokassa mahato obhāsassa mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvo hotī’ti.
kv4.7:11.1: yathā bodhisattassa pakatikāyo samantā vyāmaṃ obhāsati, evamevaṃ cakkavattisattassa pakatikāyo samantā vyāmaṃ obhāsatī’ti.
kv4.7:12.1: yathā bodhisatto mahāsupinaṃ passati, evamevaṃ cakkavattisatto mahāsupinaṃ passatī’ti.
kv4.7:13.5: “dvattiṃsimāni bhikkhave mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇāni yehi samannāgatassa mahāpurisassa dve’va gatiyo bhavanti anaññā,
kv4.7:13.6: sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati rājā hoti cakkavatti dhammiko dhammarājā cāturanto vijitāvī janapadatthāvariyappatto sattaratana samannāgato.
kv4.7:13.8: cakkaratanaṃ hatthiratanaṃ assaratanaṃ maṇiratanaṃ itthiratanaṃ gahapatiratanaṃ parināyaka ratanameva sattamaṃ.
kv4.7:13.9: parosahassaṃ kho panassa puttā bhavanti sūrā vīraṅgarūpā parasenappamaddanā.
kv4.7:13.10: so imaṃ paṭhaviṃ sāgarapariyantaṃ adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena abhivijiya ajjhāvasati.
kv4.7:13.11: sace kho pana agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati arahaṃ hoti sammāsambuddho loke vivaṭacchado”ti
